description: This file contains utility functions for internationalization and text hashing, including environment variable-based configuration for providers and models, text normalization, hashing, and segment ID generation in a software project related to document translation or localization.

methods.name: cacheNamespace
methods.description: Generates a cache namespace string based on workflow version, engine, provider, and model.

methods.name: cacheKey
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 based hash key from namespace, source and target languages, segment ID, and text hash.

methods.name: hashText
methods.description: Computes a SHA-256 hash of the normalized text string.

methods.name: hashBytes
methods.description: Calculates SHA-256 hash of a given byte array.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Trims and reduces whitespace in the input text to produce a normalized string.

methods.name: docsPiProvider
methods.description: Determines the document internationalization provider based on environment variables.

methods.name: docsPiModel
methods.description: Selects the model based on environment variables and provider.

methods.name: segmentID
methods.description: Generates a segment ID combining relative path and a short hash of text.

methods.name: splitWhitespace
methods.description: Splits input text into leading whitespace, core text, and trailing whitespace.

methods.name: isWhitespace
methods.description: Checks if a byte character is whitespace.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Logs an error message and terminates the program if error is not nil.
